summary: Ukrainian forces report control over Konstantinivka in Donetsk Oblast, while Russian strikes target infrastructure in Sumy and Dnipro. Ukrainian production of military drones for U.S. forces signals growing industrial capacity.
key_points: Ukrainian forces maintain control over Konstantinivka, Donetsk Oblast, with ongoing battles in the city's northern sector (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31384).
Russian strikes on Sumy's infrastructure caused significant damage to residential areas and injuries, including children (Source: @UkraineNow/82390).
Ukraine authorized export of F10 combat drones to U.S. military under Drone Dominance program (Source: @DeepStateUA/23619).
Russian attacks on Dnipro's industrial zones injured 4 civilians, including children (Source: @UkraineNow/82390).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 59 drones and 26 command posts over Moscow region (Source: @tass_agency/383784).
Russian missile strikes damaged infrastructure in Belgorod, causing power/water outages (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31384).
Ukrainian production of military drones surpasses Russian capabilities according to Zelenskyy (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31372).
